reviewer_statement: Provisional developer-reviewed source scientific graphics geometry on actual native R sparse joint PACE models, verified in committed tests against exact Matplotlib 1.2 data/artists (not observed green yet). R base graphics is not Matplotlib and runtime plotting return types, colors and injected axes remain outside the accepted scoped scientific domain. No independent certification.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R scientific artist geometry implements source line/image/scatter coordinates, layout, common color limits, titles, labels and failure markers. The renderer uses R base graphics and cannot return actual Python Matplotlib axes or guarantee pixel-identical output; its typed plot metadata explicitly reports matplotlib_object_identity=false.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python public src/eyetrajectoriespy/sparse_multivariate_plotting.py::plot_sparse_mfpca_cross_covariance. Two separate directional Cxy and Cyx cross-covariance heatmap source artist geometries

Real fitted joint paired sparse PACE result, stage='used' or 'smoothed', backward-compatible source alias and strict native source-scientific record option. No Python axes injection, no silent transpose to make directional raw covariance disappear.

Native strict geometry encodes source direct Cxy and Cyx matrices and shared signed symmetric max(abs(block)) color limits, exact increasing-grid image extent, directional source titles, xlabel/ylabel, and cross-covariance colorbar intent. Frozen Python 1.2 public Matplotlib imshow arrays, get_clim and source titles are compared for both stages under actual native result; plot base R colormap pixels remain distinct.
Rejects invalid stage, mutually conflicting source/stage, source-untyped fit and nonfinite or dimensionally invalid directional covariance blocks; Python backend error classes are not native.

Source Python returns two Matplotlib Axes via NumPy array plus a figure-level colorbar; native R returns an inspectable 1x2 scientific artist geometry with exact source arrays, signed limit, stage, title and cross-covariance colorbar metadata and draws native base-R heatmaps. Does not claim Python Axes identity or exact native color pixels.
Show directional sparse planar cross-covariance estimated for joint PACE, Cxy(s,t) and Cyx(s,t) separately. Avoid inadvertent self-symmetrization or replacement by univariate covariance.

independent_review_status: Scoped developer review only; exact-head CI and pinned Matplotlib differential are queued or unverified, no independent scientific contract certification.
language_specific_limits: Matplotlib Axes and Figure identity, external axes injection, and pixel-exact `coolwarm` rendering cannot be implemented by a native base-R graphics return.

Native result remains a real fitted R scientific object; Python class identity and exact error classes are not interchangeable.
No green exact-head CI observed, independent certification, main-branch merge, or CRAN readiness is claimed.
